rationale.A: Almost all on tracks beside 50 km/h arterials (Kuitinmäentie, Martinsillantie, Merituulentie); 15 lights
rationale.B: Shore route but ~2 km in mixed traffic, including Soukanväylä at 60 km/h, Kaitaantie and Haukilahdenranta
rationale.C: Inland park paths via Finnoo and Gräsanlaakso; ~40% beside 40–50 km/h roads; 3 lights
rationale.D: Shore paths via Nuottalahti and Haukilahti, no mixed traffic; ~30% beside roads, several unsignalised crossings; 1 light
rationale.E: Shore, then Matinkylä park paths; least arterial-side riding of all; 1 light; +4 min
rationale.F: Like A but cuts through Kuitinmäki residential paths; still mostly arterial-side; 9 lights
rationale.G: Kaitaa and Matinkylä park paths; little arterial-side riding, few unsignalised crossings; 3 lights
rationale.H: Like A with a Kuitinmäki jog; mostly arterial-side; 12 lights

notes: D saves 14 lights for +2 min. E (+4) moves about half the distance from arterial-side tracks to park and shore paths. D would also be a defensible calm pick.
